Metrics.Name: intune.cloud_pki.authorities
Metrics.Description: Intune Cloud PKI certification authorities by type (root/issuing) and status. Per-CA detail — decoded subject and issuer, key platform, CRL and SCEP endpoints — on the intune.cloud_pki_authority log twin.

Metrics.Name: intune.cloud_pki.days_until_expiry
Metrics.Description: Days until each Intune Cloud PKI certification authority expires, read from the CA's own certificate rather than from a Graph field; negative once expired. When an issuing CA expires every device authenticating with its certificates loses Wi-Fi/VPN/802.1X at once. A CA whose expiry cannot be established emits NO point rather than a fabricated one.

Metrics.Name: intune.cloud_pki.leaf_certificates
Metrics.Description: Leaf certificates issued by each Intune Cloud PKI certification authority, by status (active/expired/revoked). Which device and user each certificate belongs to is on the intune.cloud_pki_leaf_certificate log twin.
